record.bible_text: Keep silence<WH02790><WTH8685> before me, O islands<WH0339>; and let the people<WH03816> renew<WH02498><WTH8686> <FI>their<Fi> strength<WH03581>: let them come near<WH05066><WTH8799>; then let them speak<WH01696><WTH8762>: let us come near<WH07126><WTH8799> together<WH03162> to judgment<WH04941>.

<FI> Thou<Fi> whom I have taken<WH02388><WTH8689> from the ends<WH07098> of the earth<WH0776>, and called<WH07121><WTH8804> thee from the chief men<WH0678> thereof, and said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto thee, Thou <FI>art<Fi> my servant<WH05650>; I have chosen<WH0977><WTH8804> thee, and not cast thee away<WH03988><WTH8804>.<CM>
